newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Saules Bank launches stock market index.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Saules Bank launches stock market index.

text.p: One of Latvia's top 10 banks, Saules Bank, said on Tuesday that it has launched an index to track the Latvian stock market.
The index is called the Saule10 and consists of the 10 most liquid stocks on the bourse.
The index is based on the market capitalisations of the companies, Saules Bank Asset Management said in a statement.
"The index has been created to give domestic and foreign investors a clearer picture of movements and of the development of the Latvian stock market," Saules said.
The index is the first for the Latvian bourse although the market's management is planning to launch its own index later this year.
The base value for the Saules index is 100 and the start date is from January 1 this year.

The 10 shares included in the list are the official list shares Unibanka, Staburadze and Riga Transport Fleet as well as Daugavpils Chain, Jekabapils sugar, Kaija and Salacgriva fish canneries, the Lode brick plant, the Mangali Shipyard and the Rigas Raugs yeast plant.
The Latvian stock market was launched in 1995 with a handful of shares and now quotes more than 20.
Leading commercial bank Riga Commercial Bank and insurance firm Balta are expected to seek a bourse listing later this year.
